plugins.name: dhpk
plugins.description: Reusable Claude Code harness with role-based agents, skills, hooks, and advisory reviewer dispatch, plus a parallel Codex CLI projection. Stack modules and stack skills ship separately in dhpk-stacks.

plugins.name: dhpk-stacks
plugins.description: Stack modules and stack skills for the dhpk harness: PHP, Yii, PHPUnit, Laravel, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, and iOS/Swift hooks, references, reviewers, and skills. Requires the dhpk core plugin; owns the modules setting.
